brief:
British universities worked together with government officials and private intelligence networks to suppress pro-Palestine activism on campuses, according to findings by Amnesty International reported by Middle East Eye. The coordination involved security networks and private intelligence firms in efforts to curtail student protest activity.

The report documents systematic collaboration between academic institutions and state security apparatus targeting campus activism around Palestinian issues. Amnesty International's investigation revealed the extent of institutional coordination in managing political expression on university grounds.
